description: Native Windows task manager (official all-users installer)

script: if (!(is_admin)) { abort 'Run Scoop from an elevated PowerShell to install argus-setup.' }
if ($keys | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ }) { abort 'Uninstall the existing Argus installation before installing argus-setup.' }

if (!$folder.PSIsContainer -or ($folder.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $target -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1)) { abort 'The Argus installation path is occupied. Inspect it before continuing.' }

if ($setup.ExitCode -ne 0 -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target 'argus.exe') -PathType Leaf) -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target 'uninstall.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { abort "Argus setup did not complete (exit code: $($setup.ExitCode))." }
if (!(is_admin)) { abort 'Run Scoop from an elevated PowerShell to uninstall or update argus-setup.' }
if (!$location) { abort 'The Windows uninstall entry does not match the Scoop-managed Argus path.' }
if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $target -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { abort 'The Argus installation path is a reparse point.' }
if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $uninstall -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { abort 'The Argus uninstaller is a reparse point.' }
if ($result.ExitCode -ne 0 -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target 'argus.exe'))) { abort "Argus uninstall did not complete (exit code: $($result.ExitCode))." }
abort 'Argus is present but its uninstaller is missing. Repair the installation before continuing.'

notes: 在管理员 PowerShell 中安装、升级和卸载。安装位置为 Program Files\Argus，启动入口由官方安装程序创建。
安装版与便携版共用用户配置和历史记录，无需配置 Scoop persist。请先退出 Argus 再升级或卸载。
Scoop 升级会运行官方卸载程序后再安装新版本。建议关闭 Argus 应用内自动更新，统一用 Scoop 升级。
post_uninstall: Write-Warning 'Argus 会保留用户设置、日志和历史记录。两个版本共用数据，请在两个版本都不再使用时备份后手动清理。'
Write-Host '  如改过历史记录位置，请另外检查自定义目录。'
